description: Welcome to 117 Sutro Heights Avenue, your 3BR/2BA perch high above Ocean Beach, offering mesmerizing ocean views for miles! You'll love the soothing sounds of the waves as they come ashore and the call of the many seabirds that circle above. Sutro Heights Park is just around the corner, offering one of San Francisco's most inspiring outdoor settings -- the perfect place for an early morning walk with the dog, or the first installment of your 10,000 daily steps. Cross Geary Boulevard to Fort Miley and you'll soon be hiking along the cliffs that define the entrance to San Francisco Bay, featuring breathtaking views of the Golden Gate Bridge and the majestic Marin Headlands. When you return home from your outdoor excursions, you'll find a comfortable, turnkey home with an open living-dining floor plan with jaw-dropping panoramic views to the south, a roomy remodeled kitchen, ample cabinetry, as well as abundant counter space. Step out onto your private deck to enjoy morning coffee or a glass of Prosecco as the sky takes on the pastel colors of sunset. In addition to three spacious bedrooms and abundant closet space, this wonderful home includes two recently upgraded bathrooms - one en suite - and a functional wood-burning fireplace. One garage parking space, suitable for an SUV, and storage are included on the floor below, in addition to shared laundry appliances. Welcome home to a new day at 117 Sutro Heights Avenue. Superb and sublime!
